Open the Greylock transcript and the tweet.I found no dated AI predictions by Sam Altman from 2022. All three fixed searches ran, plus 6 more searches, and I opened 4 pages (2 of them wouldn't load). The fixed searches mostly turned up coverage of his later forecasts, especially the 2025 "by 2030" interviews.

- **Greylock "AI for the Next Era" (Reid Hoffman, published September 2022):** This is the main 2022 occasion I found. Greylock's printed transcript, which looks like an excerpt, has forward-looking lines but none with a date or a length of time. He said "with the quality of language models we'll see in the coming years, there will be a serious challenge to Google for the first time for a search product," and "I think we'll get multimodal models in not that much longer." "Coming years" is as vague as "a few years," and neither line is about when AGI arrives, so neither goes under candidates or undated.
- **Tweet on 16 November 2022:** A search result shows an Altman tweet predicting that AGI "gets built sooner" than most people think. That would belong under undated, since it's about when AGI arrives. But both X/Twitter addresses were blocked when I tried to open them, so I haven't quoted it. Someone with X access should check it at the address in the JSON.
- **Other years:** Snippets pointed to 2024 statements (the Lex Fridman transcript and the DealBook Summit) and 2025 ones (the "by 2030" interviews, the "Reflections" essay). I only saw these in search results and didn't open them, apart from the 1 noted in the JSON.
